sentences.text: Hmph. Luna, I have reviewed the data, and I find no evidence of spectral activity; the events point to a simple environmental change in the laundry room.
At 03:00, the humidity sensor recorded 33.6 %, which is significantly below the expected 37.9 %.
Maybe the laundry room window was open, allowing the air to dry out, which would explain the drop in humidity.
This fluctuation is probably just a normal atmospheric event, not anything requiring a ghost explanation.
